title: Split Logs on Order
summary: Halla Lauds says Hedda Greaves has an order for 4 split logs that cannot wait. The stock is at the apiary, and the deadline is before the pilgrims arrive for the feast.
offer_text: "Hedda Greaves has an order and nobody to fetch it. Hear Hedda out, then bring the goods from the apiary before the pilgrims arrive for the feast. I will vouch for you."

objectives.text: Take 4 split logs from the apiary
Hand the split logs to Hedda Greaves
